    """2-end chain: handle at ends[handle_idx]; other end F. Returns list of (U1,U2,h_int)."""
    F = ends[1-handle_idx]
    S=(2*target[0],2*target[1])

        if (set(diamond(*U1))|set(diamond(*U2))) & blocked: continue
        if set(diamond(*U1)) & set(diamond(*U2)): continue
        if set(hubcells(*target)) & (set(diamond(*U1))|set(diamond(*U2))): continue
        out.append((U1,U2,hi))
    return out

from collections import deque
def bfs3(s,goal,blocked,G=None):
    G=G or G3; NR=len(G); NC=len(G[0])
    def fr(r,c): return 0<=r<NR and 0<=c<NC and G[r][c]!='B' and (r,c) not in blocked
    dq=deque([(s,[])]); seen={s}
    while dq:
        (r,c),path=dq.popleft()
        if (r,c)==goal: return path
        for dr,dc in ((-2,0),(2,0),(0,-2),(0,2)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if fr(r+dr//2,c+dc//2) and fr(nr,nc) and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); dq.append(((nr,nc),path+[(dr,dc)]))
    return None

def solve(G, start, goal, guards):
    NR=len(G); NC=len(G[0])
    def ok(r,c): return 0<=r<NR and 0<=c<NC and G[r][c]!='B'
    gset=frozenset(guards)
    def danger(pos,gs):
        r,c=pos
        return any((gr==r and abs(gc-c)<=2) for (gr,gc) in gs)
    start_state=(start,gset)
    dq=deque([(start_state,[])]); seen={start_state}
    while dq:
        ((r,c),gs),path=dq.popleft()
        if (r,c)==goal: return path
        for dr,dc in ((-2,0),(2,0),(0,-2),(0,2)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not ok(r+dr//2,c+dc//2) or not ok(nr,nc): continue
            ngs = gs - {(nr,nc)}   # capture if landing on a guard
            if danger((nr,nc), ngs): continue
            s2=((nr,nc),ngs)
            if s2 in seen: continue
            seen.add(s2); dq.append((s2,path+[('UDLR'[[ -2,0,2,0,0,-2,0,2][i*2:i*2+2]==(dr,dc)][0] if False else {(-2,0):'UP',(2,0):'DOWN',(0,-2):'LEFT',(0,2):'RIGHT'}[(dr,dc)])]))
    return None

    return [W[i][1](t) for i in range(4)]
def dashcells(t):
    # cells 2-in-front of each walker, using facing = pos(t+1)-pos(t)
    s=set()
    p0=wpos(t); p1=wpos(t+1)
    for a,b in zip(p0,p1):
        dr=(b[0]-a[0])//2; dc=(b[1]-a[1])//2
        s.add((a[0]+2*dr,a[1]+2*dc))
    return s
def solve5dash(G,start,t0,goal,both=True):
    NR=len(G);NC=len(G[0]); P=140
    def ok(r,c): return 0<=r<NR and 0<=c<NC and G[r][c]!='B'
    NM={(-2,0):'UP',(2,0):'DOWN',(0,-2):'LEFT',(0,2):'RIGHT'}
    s0=(start,t0%P); dq=deque([(s0,[])]); seen={s0}
    while dq:
        ((r,c),tm),path=dq.popleft()
        if (r,c)==goal: return path
        for (dr,dc),nm in NM.items():
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc; ntm=(tm+1)%P
            if not ok(r+dr//2,c+dc//2) or not ok(nr,nc): continue
            bad = (nr,nc) in dashcells(tm)
            if both: bad = bad or (nr,nc) in dashcells(ntm)
            if bad: continue
            s2=((nr,nc),ntm)
            if s2 in seen: continue
            seen.add(s2); dq.append((s2,path+[nm]))
    return None

def solve_now(p0,p1,c0_,alive=True,maxdepth=30):

    dq=deque([(s0,[])]); seen={s0}
    while dq:
        (pos,pp,bel,alv),path=dq.popleft()
        if pos==GOAL: return path
        if len(path)>=maxdepth: continue
        for np_ in adj8(pos):
            nal = alv and np_!=(6,2)

            nb=set(); okd=True
            for c in bel:

                    if nc==np_: okd=False; break
                    nb.add(nc)
                if not okd: break
            if not okd: continue
            s2=(np_,pos,frozenset(nb),nal)
            if s2 in seen: continue
            seen.add(s2); dq.append((s2,path+[np_]))
    return None

def search9d(strict=True, maxd=34):
    st=frozenset([((4,6),False)])
    start=((8,8),(8,8), st, True, True, 0)
    dq=deque([(start,[])]); seen={((8,8),(8,8),st,True,True,0)}
    while dq:
        (pos,p1,bel,r1a,r2a,kk),path=dq.popleft()
        if len(path)>=maxd: continue
        for np_ in adj9(pos):
            nk=kk+1
            if np_ in pats2(nk): continue
            if strict and np_ in pats2(kk): continue
            if np_ in [c for c,a in bel]: continue
            if r1a and np_==(10,8): continue
            if r2a and np_==(10,6): continue
            nbel=set(); okd=True
            for (c,aw) in bel:
                naw = aw or aligned(np_,c)
                if not naw:
                    nbel.add((c,False)); continue
                for nc in cstep9(c,p1):
                    if nc==np_: okd=False; break
                    nbel.add((nc,True))
                if not okd: break
            if not okd: continue
            n1a=r1a and np_!=(10,6); n2a=r2a and np_!=(12,6)
            if np_==(10,8) and not n1a: return path+[np_]
            key=(np_,pos,frozenset(nbel),n1a,n2a,nk%8)
            if key in seen: continue

def search9e(k0,pos,p1,bel0,strict=True,maxd=32):
    dq=deque([(((pos,p1,bel0,True,True,k0)),[])])
    seen={((pos,p1,bel0,True,True,k0%8))}
    while dq:
        (pos,p1,bel,r1a,r2a,kk),path=dq.popleft()
        if len(path)>=maxd: continue
        for np_ in adj9(pos):
            nk=kk+1
            if np_ in pats2(nk): continue
            if strict and np_ in pats2(kk): continue
            if np_ in [c for c,a in bel]: continue
            if r1a and np_==(10,8): continue
            if r2a and np_==(10,6): continue
            nbel=set(); okd=True
            for (c,ph) in bel:
                if ph=='asleep':
                    if aligned(np_,c): nbel.add((c,'waking'))
                    else: nbel.add((c,'asleep'))
                    continue
                if ph=='waking': ph2='hunting'
                else: ph2='hunting'
                for nc in cstep9(c,p1):
                    if nc==np_: okd=False; break
                    nbel.add((nc,ph2))
                if not okd: break
            if not okd: continue
            n1a=r1a and np_!=(10,6); n2a=r2a and np_!=(12,6)
            if np_==(10,8) and not n1a: return path+[np_]
            key=(np_,pos,frozenset(nbel),n1a,n2a,nk%8)
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key); dq.append(((np_,pos,frozenset(nbel),n1a,n2a,nk),path+[np_]))
    return None
